title: SnowBoard Game

meta_desc: Play SnowBoard Game free online. Ride snowy slopes, carve around obstacles and snowboard your way to the finish line in a free browser winter sports game.
desc: SnowBoard Game is a winter sports run where you glide down icy tracks, carve around obstacles and ride smooth lines to the finish. Each descent mixes speed with tight avoidance.
howto: Steer your boarder down the slope.
Weave between rocks, trees and course markers.
Keep your speed through open sections.
Reach the finish line to clear the run.
tips: Start your turn before the obstacle, not at it.
Wide berths cost less speed than crashes.
Learn each track's first corners — they set your rhythm.
